_comment: Typed option vocabulary. Every option a manifest may declare is defined here once: its type, UI metadata (legacy free-text 'range' string kept for Prompt Builder compatibility) and, per score-template family, how it is passed to the provider ('body_key' = request body field, 'cast' = Python coercion). An option without an entry for a family is not supported there and mdb validate reports it.

temperature.description: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2. Higher values like 0.8 will make the output more random, while lower values like 0.2 will make it more focused and deterministic.

top_p.description: An alternative to sampling with temperature, called nucleus sampling, where the model considers the results of the tokens with top_p probability mass. So 0.1 means only the tokens comprising the top 10% probability mass are considered.

top_k.description: The topK parameter changes how the model selects tokens for output. A topK of 1 means the selected token is the most probable among all the tokens in the model's vocabulary (also called greedy decoding), while a topK of 3 means that the next token is selected from among the 3 most probable using the temperature. For each token selection step, the topK tokens with the highest probabilities are sampled. Tokens are then further filtered based on topP with the final token selected using temperature sampling.

max_tokens.description: Limits the amount of output tokens generated by the model.

max_completion_tokens.label: Max Tokens
max_completion_tokens.description: Limits the total tokens generated by a reasoning model, including internal reasoning tokens. Use this instead of max_tokens for reasoning models.

seed.label: Seed
seed.description: If specified, the provider makes a best effort to sample deterministically, so that repeated requests with the same seed and parameters return similar results.

frequency_penalty.label: Frequency Penalty
frequency_penalty.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim.

presence_penalty.label: Presence Penalty
presence_penalty.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics.

reasoning_effort.label: Reasoning Effort
reasoning_effort.description: How much effort a reasoning model spends thinking before it answers. Higher levels improve quality on hard problems at the cost of latency and tokens. The normalized level is translated to what the specific provider supports (e.g. OpenAI reasoning_effort, Anthropic effort, Gemini thinking_level).

thinking_budget.label: Thinking Budget
thinking_budget.description: Number of tokens an extended-thinking model may spend on internal reasoning before answering. 0 disables extended thinking.

input_type.label: Input Type
input_type.description: Whether the text is embedded as a document (for storage/indexing) or as a query (for retrieval). Using the matching type on both sides improves retrieval quality.

Embedding_Mode.label: Embedding Mode
Embedding_Mode.description: Whether the text is embedded as a query (for retrieval) or as a document (for storage/indexing). Using the matching mode on both sides improves retrieval quality.

dimensions.label: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Number of dimensions the returned embedding should have (only for models that support shortening embeddings).

normalize.label: Normalize Vector
normalize.description: Whether to normalize the returned embedding vector to unit length (recommended for retrieval).

Embedding_Length.label: Embedding Length
Embedding_Length.description: The length of the returned embedding vector.

Input_Token_Limit.label: Input Token Limit
Input_Token_Limit.description: The limit of input tokens for the embedding model.

api_key.description: This is the {key_name} key that is used to make the actual request.
